requirement.statement: The skill SHALL expose a generic FS-native resource system with source shapes, first-level catalogs, KindDefinition authority, logical identity, containment, registry, and stable diagnostics.

case.given: The skill is opened by an author or validator
case.when: The generic resource system is inspected
case.then: The system SHALL be organized as system/foundation, system/std, system/spec, and system/examples

case.given: A manifest declares a FileResourceCatalog, DirectoryResourceCatalog, or ManifestResourceCatalog
case.then: The system SHALL scan only the declared root's first level and validate every member through the catalog Kind's KindDefinition

requirement.statement: The ontology domain SHALL be an upper Kind package on the FS-native system, with Ontology as a manifest Kind and every ontology resource category as a registered resource Kind.

case.given: The ontology business specification is inspected
case.when: Its documentation and examples are loaded
case.then: The domain SHALL be organized as ontology-domain/foundation, ontology-domain/std, ontology-domain/spec, and ontology-domain/examples

case.given: An Ontology composes lower kernels, profiles, Operations, Evidence, Bindings, Mappings, and Evolution
case.then: The Ontology SHALL use direct FS-native ResourceCatalog children and SHALL NOT use Ontology/Resources, Ontology/Modules, or per-resource href assembly

case.given: An ontology resource is discovered by a ResourceCatalog
case.then: The member SHALL declare its resource Kind, fqn identity, semantic identity where required, and non-empty Description and SHALL match the catalog KindDefinition

requirement.statement: The validator SHALL discover ontology resources through FS-native catalogs and KindDefinitions before applying ontology-domain semantic validation.

case.given: An input uses Ontology/Resources, Ontology/Modules, explicit resource href entries, or the retired assets/examples layout
case.then: The validator SHALL reject it with a stable FS-native migration diagnostic and SHALL NOT translate it

case.given: A valid FS-native Ontology resource tree
case.then: The validator SHALL preserve lower/upper ownership, five Operation dimensions, complete ExecuteOperationRequest v1, capability-role separation, evidence, binding, mapping, evolution, and VFS/XML security checks

requirement.statement: The ontology XML skill SHALL treat depa-ontology.ts as the Bun OM capability authority and SHALL require explicit import/export projection policy.

case.given: A valid FS-native ontology tree and declared runtime mappings
case.when: The ontology is imported into Bun OM
case.then: The importer SHALL use public depa-ontology.ts schema and behavior surfaces only after XML validation

case.given: Only runtime schema rows, snapshots, or behavior manifests are available
case.then: The exporter SHALL NOT fabricate BusinessObject, Operation, Evidence, policy, lifecycle, or other profile-only facts without explicit export policy and evidence

requirement.statement: System and ontology-domain examples SHALL be newly authored, compact, and scoped to demonstrating their own layer.

case.then: The examples SHALL use a new neutral domain and the minimum files needed to demonstrate all three shapes, catalogs, KindDefinition registration, and nested manifest composition

case.when: The complete ontology capability is learned or tested
case.then: The examples SHALL use a newly authored non-IT-Asset domain covering every retained ontology concern and focused invalid cases
